text:
sam (oncall): I'm going to flip ingress.match_precedence from 10 -> 0 for the /v1/generate route on gateway-prod to bypass an old quota header rule that's misclassifying premium clients. Doing it in 30s, will watch metrics for 15m. please don't touch routing rules while i'm watching.
maria (eng-platform): can you paste the exact patch you're going to apply? also which config map / config-source? need to update rollout UI note if this is live toggle.
sam (oncall): kubectl -n infra patch configmap route-policies -p '{"data":{"ingress.match_precedence":"0"}}' --type=merge
(doing via automated deploy-job so we have an execution id)
julian (telemetry): which metrics to watch: 5xx rate (/v1/generate), p50/p95 latency, and token spend per-route. I'll open a temporary dashboard. also add the quota-mismatch alert to the watch.
monitor-bot: Alert created: dashboard/temp/ingress-toggle-1768883333; will refresh every 10s.
ops (infra): if traffic spikes, we should be ready to force a canary split back to policy-route with a weight 90/10. I have the playbook snippet if needed.
kai (console): heads up — I'll pin a notice in the rollout UI and set the toggle description to indicate emergency override + who executed it. makes audits easier.
maria (eng-platform): rollback plan in thread: 1) reapply ingress.match_precedence=10 via same configmap patch 2) clear gateway prefix cache: POST /admin/prefix-cache/flush 3) if persistent issues, flip route-weight for /v1/generate back to stable pool. who will run step 2?
sam (oncall): i'll run 2 if needed. step 1 command: kubectl -n infra patch configmap route-policies -p '{"data":{"ingress.match_precedence":"10"}}' --type=merge
maria (eng-platform): add preflight checks before rollback: confirm no more increased 5xx for 5 consecutive 30s windows, and confirm token spend normalized. we shouldn't revert unless those conditions met.
julian (telemetry): dashboard live: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/ingress-toggle-1768883333?orgId=1 — watching p95 and 503s now.
sam (oncall): toggle applied at 1768883360. initial drop in 503s, p95 up ~30ms, token rate +6% (expected). monitoring.
monitor-bot: Alert: 503 rate for /v1/generate reduced from 2.4% -> 0.4% over 60s window.
ops (infra): graceful: if you need to roll back, also revoke the emergency flag in route-metadata to avoid automated routing re-eval kicking it back.
maria (eng-platform): noted. I'll create a small rollback runbook in the console (short link appended).
sam (oncall): okay running watch for 15m. will revert early if latency or error budget breached.
monitor-bot: 10m elapsed — p95 stable, no error budget alerts.
sam (oncall): reverting ingress.match_precedence -> 10 now, per planned window.
julian (telemetry): I'll snapshot metrics at revert time for regression check.
sam (oncall): revert applied at 1768883920. post-revert: 503s remain low, p95 back to baseline.
maria (eng-platform): thanks. I'll update the rollout UI note: "emergency precedence override applied 1768883360 by sam; reverted 1768883920. root cause: legacy quota header rule mis-ordered. follow-up: make match_precedence rule explicit in policy schema and add integration test."
ops (infra): please file a small incident with RCA + action items so we can schedule a fix.
sam (oncall): filing incident now. thumbs up if nothing else. :thumbsup:
